messages:
maya-support: Forwarding customer report — they were charged twice after a renewal. Invoices INV-5223 and INV-5224, charges ch_3LkX... and ch_3LkY..., payment intents pi_1JxA..., PO number PO-4321. Customer attached screenshots and says they pressed manual ‘Pay now’ right after auto-renew. Can someone triage?

amelia: Thanks — assigning to billing ops @samir. Any quick guesses on dedupe?

samir: I'll take this. Can you paste full charge/payment IDs and any webhook ids? Also did the customer use the console pay_now toggle?

maya-support: Pasted details from the customer: charges: ch_3LkXabc123 (auto), ch_3LkYdef456 (manual). payment_intents: pi_1JxA_auto, pi_1JxB_manual. webhook id wh_98765. Timestamps: 2027-05-10T14:02:11Z (auto), 2027-05-10T14:03:25Z (manual). Card initially declined then retried successfully.

samir: Quick look in ops logs — looks like we created two invoices because the auto-renew path didn't set external_id when PO handling raced with payment confirmation. Manual checkout created a new invoice when PO was present. Need logs excerpt.

samir: ```
billing:create_invoice external_id=null invoice_id=5223 source=auto-renew request_id=rid_abc123
billing:create_invoice external_id=PO-4321 invoice_id=5224 source=manual request_id=rid_def456
```

jordan: From infra: our dedupe is external_id || payment_intent. Auto-renew didn't attach external_id for the PO path, and the payment_intent on the auto-renew was created but not yet persisted as external_id before manual flow ran. So we ended up with two invoices. We'll need to dedupe on payment_intent always.

samir: Agreed. Immediate customer remediation: void the duplicate invoice 5224 (manual) and refund ch_3LkY..., then create a credit note linking to PO-4321. I'll do that now. Tagging @liam-finance for reconciliation. ETA ~30m.

liam-finance: Noted. Please include refund tx id and credit_note number. Also customer is EU-based — confirm VAT reverse-charge handling on the credit note.

billing-bot: Refund initiated: rfd_90123 for charge ch_3LkYdef456. Credit note CN-2027-421 created. Invoice 5224 voided. Refund reference rfd_90123.

maya-support: Passed update to customer; they received the refund confirmation email and asked for assurance this won't happen again.

jordan: We'll push a hotfix to ensure auto-renew sets external_id before invoice creation and add an always-on dedupe check on payment_intent. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/ops/pull/1234 (internal). Deploy scheduled during next maintenance window and will emit a duplicate-invoice metric and alert.

amelia: Thanks team. @maya-support please send a short summary to the customer: refund issued, duplicate invoice voided, credit note issued, engineering fix underway — we'll follow up when deployed.

maya-support: Sent summary to customer. They replied :thumbsup: and consider this resolved from their side. Closing thread.
